blurb: World of Racing offers sim racing experiences using full-motion racing simulators for realistic motorsport thrills. Guests can race individually or in groups, with coaching available for skill improvement. Memberships provide regular seat time and access to events and community features.
extraNote: No refunds for memberships or race credit purchases · Race credits do not expire if membership is active · Memberships renew automatically every 4 weeks · Cancel membership at least 72 hours before next billing by email · All memberships have an 8-week minimum (2 billing cycles) · Cancellation policy: cancel 24 hours prior to scheduled time to avoid deduction · No-shows hurt business; same cancellation policy for members and regular drivers · At the sim racing center location booked
